# The PostgreSQL functions this package neither translates nor refuses by name,
# so a query naming one reaches SQLite and fails with "no such function".
#
# This file is the debt, written down. TestEveryEngineFunctionHasAnAnswer reads
# it and fails when a name that is not here joins them, which is what keeps the
# list from growing while nobody is looking; a name leaves it by being
# translated or by being refused with a reason, and the test fails then too,
# which is what keeps the file honest.
#
# Every name here is one PostgreSQL answers, checked against a running
# PostgreSQL 17. None of them is an internal or an administrative function --
# those are refused by name already -- so each is a gap rather than a decision.
DATE_ADD
DATE_SUBTRACT
ENUM_FIRST
ENUM_LAST
GET_BIT
IS_NORMALIZED
JSONB_PATH_EXISTS_TZ
JSONB_PATH_MATCH_TZ
JSONB_PATH_QUERY_ARRAY_TZ
JSONB_PATH_QUERY_FIRST_TZ
JSONB_PATH_QUERY_TZ
JSONB_SET_LAX
MAKE_TIMESTAMPTZ
OVERLAPS
REGEXP_MATCH
REGEXP_MATCHES
SET_BIT
TIMEZONE
TO_BIN
TO_OCT
UNICODE_ASSIGNED
UNICODE_VERSION
UUID_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP
UUID_EXTRACT_VERSION
